newsitem.title: USA: Adidas in $100 mln pact with Yankees - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Adidas in $100 mln pact with Yankees - WSJ.

text.p: Adidas AG appears to be the winner of a 10-year marketing deal with the New York Yankees baseball team estimated at roughly $100 million, Monday's electronic edition of the Wall Street Journal said.
People familiar with the deal told the paper Adidas won the pact over Fila, which emerged as a potential suitor Friday.

Under the initial agreement, Adidas was to obtain the right to make uniforms for the Yankees and to sell uniform replicas to the public, the report said. It said there were also discussions over the possibility of incorporating Adidas' three-stripe logo on the team's white-and-navy home-game uniforms.

The pact with the winners of the 1996 World Series is more than three times the sum of any existing sponsorship agreement with an individual U.S. team, second only to Nike's 10-year, $200 million sponsorship of Brazil's world-champion national soccer team, the report said.
